name: wanderweird-travel
description: Wanderweird — fun Expo travel showcase with Mockifyer-backed Node services + Umbraco CMS

scripts.dev: cross-env MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3002 concurrently -n gateway,auth,trips,wander,cms,lore,graphql -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,white,blue,red "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/gateway-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/auth-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/trips-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/wander-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/cms-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/lore-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/graphql-api"
scripts.dev:record: cross-env MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3002 MOCKIFYER_RECORD=true concurrently -n gateway,auth,trips,wander,cms,lore,graphql -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,white,blue,red "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/gateway-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/auth-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/trips-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/wander-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/cms-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/lore-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/graphql-api"
scripts.dev:record:stubs: cross-env MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3002 MOCKIFYER_RECORD=true MOCKIFYER_RECORD_RESPONSES=false MOCKIFYER_ACTIVATION_MODE=client_id_header concurrently -n gateway,auth,trips,wander,cms,lore,graphql -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,white,blue,red "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/gateway-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/auth-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/trips-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/wander-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/cms-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/lore-api" "npm run dev -w @wanderweird/graphql-api"
